description: One read-only MCP endpoint for 40+ business systems, so an agent can answer a question that spans several of them at once. Every figure is returned with the source system it was read from.

notes: OAuth 2.1. Each connected system authorizes independently and read-only, and the hosted service keeps the connection rather than the data.

clients: Claude (web and desktop) and ChatGPT as native connectors
VS Code and any MCP-capable client over the remote endpoint.
license: Proprietary hosted service; the public repository carries the published registry manifest, not server code or a licensed package.

notes: Official MCP Registry lists io.corpusiq/multi-source-mcp (v1.0.3, isLatest true) with the same Streamable HTTP endpoint.
